results.title: Clarities
results.overview: An ominous chain text spreads across the world as Earth’s first hotel rocketship prepares for launch.

results.title: Daddy Is A Hunter
results.overview: A school counselor meets with a troubled student where he learns about the boy's intense at-home life, his father's late night desertions, and the monstrous secret beneath it all.

results.title: Interstate
results.overview: Set in 2009, a group of lost high school graduates embark on a road trip to find themselves before they enter the next chapter of their lives. However, their plans take a twist when both old and new drama emerges, threatening to break their fragile group bond.

results.title: Back To The Past Plus+
results.original_title: 尋秦記 Plus+ 多元宇宙版
results.overview: Wrongly imprisoned after Hong Siu-lung’s time-traveling disappearance, Ken was wrongly imprisoned and lost everything. After his release, he leads his daughter Galie and a team to steal the Cme machine. Equipped with a face-duplication device, Ken plans to pose as the Qin Emperor and realize his dream of being king as his way of making up for everything he lost. Meanwhile, in the Qin Dynasty, Hong Siu-lung has been living in seclusion in the countryside with his wives Kam Ching and Ting-fong, his son Bowie, and his blood brother. Life looks peaceful on the surface, but the family are closely watched by the Qin Emperor. Ken launches an ambush on the Qin Emperor, but the emperor manages to escape. Meanwhile, Hong knows that as the only person who knows that the Qin Emperor is actually impersonated his disciple, he will be worthless once the Qin unites the warring states. To protect his family, Hong decides to uproot his family.

results.title: M.I.S.S.I.O.N. Opera Undercover Agent
results.original_title: M.I.S.S.I.O.N. 歌劇な潜入捜査官
results.overview: Matsumi Kanata, a brilliant but antisocial Tokyo police detective, is tasked with a secret mission: infiltrate Tsubakino University of the Arts to identify the culprit behind a series of drone bombings. Because the institution was recently an all-women's university and remains predominantly female, Kanata is forced to disguise himself as a woman to blend in.  During his undercover assignment, he crosses paths with three distinct students: Haruna, the vocal department's star performer; Misuzu, who grows hostile after losing a musical role to Kanata; and Riko, who discovers his true identity but becomes his investigative partner.  As Kanata immerses himself in student life, he gets so swept up in rehearsals for the upcoming musical production that he begins neglecting his mission. Everything comes to a head on the day of the performance when a sudden dramatic turn forces Kanata to balance saving the musical with finally uncovering the bomber's true identity.

results.title: Goodbye Postman
results.overview: Stefan, Markus, and Dieter are among the last postmen of their kind – some have been doing the job for nearly half a century. At Kronberg’s delivery hub, they see how letters are getting smaller, parcels are getting bigger, and their familiar working world is gradually disappearing. Although scanners and efficiency targets now set the pace, they hold fast to their professional ethos: the route doesn’t end until the deliveries are all made. Because there are familiar faces at every drop-off point.

results.title: Kübleross
results.overview: Izzi and Alice are two friends going through a rough patch after the loss of their mutual friend. Caught between unspoken words and grief, the two artists struggle to connect and confront their inner demons.

results.title: Wenn das Licht gefriert
results.overview: Elisabeth has been married to Friedrich for 40 years and they’ve been happy, despite a few setbacks. Not even his Alzheimer’s disease can shake their love. Until one evening, during a TV show about the unsolved murder of their daughter’s best friend—which has remained a mystery for 22 years—Friedrich suddenly mentions details he shouldn’t possibly know.

results.title: Happy Birthday, Mark
results.overview: Mark receives a late birthday gift from his best friend.

results.title: River Dreams
results.overview: Young women imagine themselves as a river: what starts off as a poetic metaphor is linked to images of landscape and becomes a many-voiced narration, radically morphing into a political statement. The Kazakh woman, she prefers life without man.

results.title: Voyage voyage, les stars chantent au Maroc
results.original_title: Voyage voyage, les stars chantent au Maroc

results.title: Michael J Fox: Actor, Activist, Optimist
results.original_title: Michael J Fox: Actor, Activist, Optimist
results.overview: No one could predict the kind of life Michael J Fox would live. From his meteoric rise to movie stardom to the tragedy of contracting Parkinson's at just 29, his life, in a way, has been a movie in itself.

results.title: September 21
results.overview: A caregiver navigates the emotional strain of caring for a man living with Alzheimer's disease, exploring the quiet struggles of memory loss, disorientation, and the toll the condition takes on families who face it daily.

results.title: Soldiers
results.overview: In a time of political turmoil, a striking factory worker struggles to find sexual satisfaction. As unrest turns to violence, his desire takes him down an unexpected path.

results.title: Christmas on the North Pole Express
results.original_title: Christmas on the North Pole Express
results.overview: A woman named Cassidy rides a train to her small, home town, and explores her past, present, and future in different cars in the train.

results.title: Wild
results.overview: Wild is a survival dramedy set in the breath-taking yet unforgiving Scottish Highlands. Lou, Dev, and Alistair, three old friends clinging to their annual wild camping tradition, begin with banter, nostalgia, and amateur vlogging, but soon unravel into a battle of egos, secrets, and survival when they get lost, food runs short, and friendships fracture. At once funny, poignant, and unsettling, "Wild" explores the line between adventure and recklessness, and how toxic masculinity has become a huge part of the epidemic decline in men’s mental health.

results.title: Pickleball
results.overview: When foreclosure threatens their community center, Father Joseph rallies his late friend’s sons into an underdog pickleball team for a $100,000 tournament—against a cocky tennis legend determined to seize the courts and steal the spotlight.

results.title: Despedirse
results.overview: After a tragic event, Noah must take a road trip to say goodbye.
